details.biography: Yung Lee was born in Malaysia and was raised in Canada. He started making his own films on YouTube and progressed with his fight skills and is now known for his action design in films like Solo: A Star Wars Story, Kingsman, and Shang-Chi. He is married to actress Meng'er Zhang.
